page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with line numbers (5, 10, 15 ... 35) in the right margin. Running head at top, page number top left. Catchword at bottom right.

main_text.p: 2.Reg.19.verf.35. Nocte prodiens angelus Domini percussit in castris Assyriorum centum octoginta quinque millia.
a) hominibus impiis vel piis, plurimum tamen piis, aliquid nuntiare. 5
b) pios protegere, illorumq; animas in cœlum deferre.
e) impios reges coercere, ne noceant piis. 10
f) homines in fine seculi a quatuor mundi plagis colliget.

a) Impio Bileamo Num.22.v.32.& deinceps. Piis: vt, Lotho, Gen.19.v.13. Manoacho, parenti Simsonis, Iudic.c.13. v.3.4.5. Danieli, Dan.8.verf.16.cap.9.verf.21. & seqq. Zachariæ, patri Iohannis Baptistæ, Luc.1. verf.13. Mariæ virgini, ibid.verf.26. & deinceps. Pastoribus Bethlehemiticis Luc.2. verf.10.& seqq. Iosepho, marito Mariæ virginis, Matth.1. verf.20.& deinceps.cap.2.v.13.19.20. mulieribus Christum quærentibus in sepulchro, Matth.28. verf.5. apostolis spe-ctantibus Christum ascendentem in cœlum, Actor.1.v.10. & seqq. Iohanni apostolo in ecstasin rapto, Apoc.1.v.1. 15

p.i: Castra metatur angelus Iehovæ circa timentes eum, & eripit eos.

main_text.p: Psal.91.verf.11.12. Angelis suis præcipiet de te, vt conseruent te in omnibus viis tuis: ambabus palmis sustinebunt te, ne offendas ad lapidem pedem tuum. Confer Hebr.1. verf.14. Exempla vide Genes.19.verf.10.16. in historia Lothi, Genes.32.verf.1. in historia Iacobi, 1.Reg.19.verf.5.& seqq. de Elia, 2.Reg.6.verf.16. & seqq. de Elisæo, 2.Reg.19.verf.35. de Sennacheribo cæso, & Hiskia liberato. Dan.3.verf.35. de tribus sociis Danielis, Dan.6.verf.23. de Daniele in fovea leonum. 20 25
Luc.16.verf.22. Lazarus apportatur ab angelis in sinum Abrahæ.
c) 2.Sam.24. verf.15.17. Angelus Iehovæ percussit peste viros septuaginta mille. 30 35

page.notes: Line numbers 5 to 35 in the right margin were transcribed as notes. "peste" in the last line is written with a Cyrillic-looking "e" in the transcription; the Latin word is "peste". Doubtful readings: "caeso" (Sennacherib line) and "Dan.3.verf.35" (printed as such; may be a printing error for 25). Long s rendered as plain s throughout. The line "Psal.91" reads "conserue" in the scan with a v; given as "conseruent".
